facts.fact: Sierraloaded reports the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security launched a weather index insurance scheme with Activa, SLICOM and UNCDF that uses satellite monitoring of weather to trigger payouts, piloted in 3 districts for rice and maize.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security with Activa International Insurance, SLICOM, UNCDF

note: No count of farmers reached is stated.
